title: Singapore denies power cut caused causeway jam, blames maintenance, breakdowns
text:
Singapore denies power cut caused causeway jam, blames maintenance, breakdowns | South China Morning Post Southeast Asia - Southeast Asia Singapore denies power cut caused causeway jam, blames maintenance, breakdowns Advertisement Singapore Asia Southeast Asia Singapore denies power cut caused causeway jam, blames maintenance, breakdowns 
 The border authority says that while maintenance works were going on at one checkpoint, truck clearance continued at Woodlands
 2 -MIN READ 2 -MIN Listen CNA Published: 7:44pm, 5 Nov 2026 Updated: 7:47pm, 5 Nov 2026 Singapore ’s Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) on Thursday rejected a report that a power outage at Woodlands Checkpoint caused traffic congestion along the causeway and on several roads in Johor Bahru on Wednesday. In its account of Wednesday’s events, ICA said a build-up of Singapore-bound traffic occurred amid planned electrical maintenance works, while two vehicle breakdowns on the Malaysian side of the causeway subsequently contributed to traffic tailing back into Malaysia . Malaysian newspaper The Star had earlier reported that the congestion, which it said began at about noon on Wednesday, was caused by a “massive power outage” at Woodlands checkpoint.
